title: C6 Pack Payload
description: Language-neutral payload sections of an Atlas pack (architecture-spec section 2.3; V3-PACK-FR-001). Every section is OPTIONAL at skeleton stage and typed when present. Sections are pack CONTENT (Tier 2); this schema defines their SHAPE, not their values. SCOPE GUARD (V3 today): date tokens and quarantine RULES are engine-global, NOT per-vertical, so they are deliberately absent from this schema. A pack may carry validation_quarantine_refs (references to engine-global or pack-declared suites), never the date-token table or quarantine rule bodies. additionalProperties is false so an over-reaching producer that tries to ship date_tokens or quarantine_rules is rejected.

canonical_schema.description: Neutral canonical schema (Tier 2). NOT a Pydantic or TS type: either an embedded JSON Schema or a field-catalog list. PII classification per field where known.

schema.description: Embedded JSON Schema when style is json-schema.

mapping_rules.description: Source-to-canonical mapping rule sets. Reuses the existing DIS shape (version, rename, normalize, cast, derive) so the DIS loader parses pack-delivered rules with no shape change.

validation_quarantine_refs.description: References to validation and quarantine suites. REFS ONLY. Quarantine RULES and the date-token table are engine-global today (scope guard); the pack points at them, it does not embed them.

kpi_definitions.description: Pack KPI and metric definitions (D01 gold layer; V3-INS-FR-003 for CAC).

funnel_stages.description: Ordered funnel stage set. The neutral FunnelStage shape (vertical-agnostic; @cortex/cac-types FunnelStage). The concrete stage list is pack content, never shared types (ADR-CAC-002).

cost_ontology.description: Cost-line-to-stage assignment with allocation rule (the funnel-economics cost-line input shape minus the runtime amount). Allocation basis is a per-cost-line attribute, not a stage attribute.

benchmark_values.description: Cold-start benchmark values (industry benchmarks for cold start). Keyed numeric targets, for example sourced composite CVRs.

scoring_rule_refs.description: References to scoring rules (A06 format). Refs only at v0; rule bodies are intelligence-plane content.

model_refs.description: References to models the pack binds to (A02/A04: signed, versioned, engine-compat-declared).

mapping_rule_set.description: The DIS mapping rule shape. `version` here is the rule-set version int, distinct from the pack SemVer version and the DIS mapping_version_id.
mapping_rule_set.$comment: The normalize/derive/cast op vocabulary below is a CLOSED set sourced from DIS libs/dis-mapping (the SourceMapping model and its validate_normalize_args / validate_derive_generator_args / validate_cast_spec). It encodes the language-neutral semantic both a TS producer and the Python (DIS) consumer must agree on: the op/generator/cast NAMES and their REQUIRED ARGS. A fixture that passes here must load as a DIS SourceMapping in vocabulary terms; an unknown op or a missing required arg is rejected. Adding or renaming an op, generator, cast type, or required arg is a contract version change, not an editorial edit. DIS value-level rules (e.g. separator-must-be-one-char, normalize-before-cast composition typing, decimal precision/scale ranges) are deliberately NOT encoded here: they are DIS implementation details, not the shared shape.

normalize_op.description: One atomic normalize-vocabulary op (DIS NORMALIZE_OPS). `op` is a closed enum; `args` carries the op's declared args with additionalProperties false (unknown args are rejected, mirroring DIS extra-forbid).

derive_generator.description: A derive generator op (DIS DERIVE_GENERATOR_OPS). A derive list MUST start with one of these; `op` is a closed enum and `args` carries the generator's required args.

derive_list.description: A derive target's ORDERED op list: a generator at position 0, then zero or more normalize-vocabulary ops (DIS bounds derive to the normalize vocabulary). One composition rule is STRUCTURAL and encoded below (date_from_datetime admits no following op); the copy/constant composition rules are not expressible in JSON Schema and stay DIS-loader-enforced.

allOf.$comment: STRUCTURAL type-flow rule from DIS SourceMapping._validate_derive_list: every normalize-vocabulary op is typed string -> string, while date_from_datetime yields a date, so a date cannot feed a string-consuming normalize op and DIS rejects ANY op following a date_from_datetime generator. That generator's output type is fixed by the op (unconditional, no value or cross-section dependency), so the rule is decidable from shape alone and is encoded here as 'a date_from_datetime list has exactly one element'. The analogous copy/constant rules are deliberately NOT encoded: copy's output type is the source column's cast type (a reference into the sibling cast section, inexpressible in JSON Schema) and constant's is the literal value's python type; both remain DIS-loader-enforced.

cast_spec.description: A cast target type (DIS CastType). `type` is a closed enum; the decimal(p,s) form requires precision and scale, and no other type may carry them.

allOf.$comment: Non-direct cost lines must declare a basis (the primitive spreads by basis).
